exchange.line: Which is a kind of selling, I suppose.

options.say: Claim Two. Producing, mind. But my sister's poorly and Sacramento's four days.

options.text: You seem cheerful for a man with a poorly sister.
options.say: I've made my peace with it.

options.beat: The swindle. Four dollars and the watch for the deed.

opening.speaker: deke_vessel

options.text: You sold me a worthless claim.
options.say: I sold you a claim. Worth is your department. Mine's volume.

options.text: I want my four dollars back.
options.say: They're working, son. Money works out here.

options.text: Teach me to lie like that.
options.say: Can't teach it. Can demonstrate it.
I answer for it constantly. Nobody accepts the answer.

options.text: I need you to sign an affidavit.

exchange.speaker: deke_vessel
exchange.line: Sign a paper saying I sold you mud under false pretenses? Son, that's a confession with a stamp on it.

exchange.speaker: deke_vessel
exchange.line: Tell you what. We'll settle it the local way.

options.text: Thank you. This has been clarifying.
